post.title: Kitchen Remodel Sammamish WA — Permits, City Electrical, Range Hood Ventilation and Water District Checks
post.description: A Sammamish kitchen remodel guide: when the City requires a remodel permit, why the City (not L&I) issues electrical permits, fixture counts and water district certificates, range hood rules, inspections and hiring.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-22 packets (latest *-2026-11-21); PC not touched. Topic: kitchen remodel in Sammamish WA. City of Sammamish pages: Getting Started and FAQs (alterations/repairs generally require a permit; 'changing the layout of a home'; Project Guidance free; MyBuildingPermit; building and electrical fees based on fair market value; contractor registration RCW 18.27; construction hours SMC 16.05.030; expiration SMC 16.20.225); Residential Remodel Submittal Checklist (Building / Single-Family Residential / Remodel; required items incl. as-is and proposed plan set, narrative, Residential Fixture Count Form; potentially applicable sewer/water availability certificates from Sammamish Plateau Water or NE Sammamish Water & Sewer District when >50% assessed value or added fixtures; water meter sizing form); Permitting Process PDF (4 working day screening, 90 day corrections); Plan Review and Inspections (city-issued Building, Plumbing, Mechanical permits; do not cover before inspection; ready at 8:00 am); Adopted Codes (2024 Sammamish Electrical Code RCW 19.28, IRC, IMC, IFGC, NFPA 54, UPC, WSEC); Building Division (electrical inspector on staff; staff-transition service notice); Project Guidance (one-week response); Permit Center hours/walk-ins. L&I City Electrical Permits & Inspections lists Sammamish (L&I does not issue permits there). WAC 51-51-1503 (M1503.3 exhaust discharge, ductless exception, M1503.5) and WAC 51-51-1505 (M1505.4.4.1 local exhaust; Table M1505.4.4.3 65% CE/160 cfm electric, 80% CE/250 cfm combustion; 300 cfm other intermittent). 2021 WSEC-R R403.6, Table R403.6.1 range hoods 2.8 cfm/W, R403.6.2 exception, R404.1, R404.2. L&I Verify + hiring a contractor. Sammamish already in _SLUG_PLACES/_PLACE_NAMES; generate_site.py unchanged; sammamish.html unchanged.
